description: Dictionary-free reversible title graph: preserve literal page titles, encode matching link targets as IDs, then reconstruct forward and backward links with a two-pass inverse.
terminal_evidence: The exact 1M IR removes 3,967 raw bytes and saves 52 LZMA bytes before its mode byte, but the guarded target archive is 174,134 versus 173,963, a 171-byte regression. At 10M it removes 20,682 raw bytes but loses 28 LZMA bytes and falls back to literal.
evidence_boundary: Negative reversible representation evidence only; no score claim.
